name: screen-tunnel
title: Phone tunnel
description: Phones recede down a corridor on either side of a headline.

props.name: opening
props.doc: The line the shot opens on: a muted first word, then the rest in the accent.

props.name: words
props.doc: The sentence that builds at the end, one entry per word.

props.name: uiFont
props.doc: Google Fonts family of the headline.

props.name: ground
props.doc: The ground, which fills the corridor.

props.name: tint
props.doc: The ground colour of the screens on the walls.

props.name: tiles
props.doc: The four colours of the tiles and dots drawn on the screens.

props.name: pullBack
props.doc: How far the camera pulls back: 1 is the full move, 0 a still camera on the corridor.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Space left between neighbouring phones, as a share of each wall: 0 has the phones meet at the seams, 0.12 the default spacing.

props.name: shadow
props.doc: Strength of the drop shadows under the headline: 0 is flat type, 1 the default lift.

props.name: grain
props.doc: Film grain over the whole frame.
